#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Trinity Compress - Pre-run prompt compression for iterative AI dev loops
# Reduces input tokens by compressing prompt files before your loop runs

set -euo pipefail

# Configuration
SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/.." && pwd)"
CONFIG_FILE="$PROJECT_ROOT/trinity-compress.config.json"
BACKUP_DIR="$PROJECT_ROOT/.trinity-backups"

# Colors for output
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

# Print usage
usage() {
    echo "Usage: $0 [mode] [options]"
    echo ""
    echo "Modes:"
    echo "  light       - Minimal compression, preserves all content"
    echo "  balanced    - Default compression level"
    echo "  aggressive  - Maximum compression, may reduce clarity"
    echo "  undo        - Restore all .bak backups from last run"
    echo "  status      - Show compression statistics"
    echo ""
    echo "Options:"
    echo "  -h, --help  Show this help message"
    echo "  -v, --verbose  Verbose output"
    echo "  --dry-run    Show what would be done without making changes"
    exit 0
}

# Check requirements
check_requirements() {
    local missing=0
    
    if ! command -v jq &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${RED}Error: 'jq' is required but not installed.${NC}" >&2
        missing=1
    fi
    
    if ! command -v bc &> /dev/null; then
        echo -e "${RED}Error: 'bc' is required but not installed.${NC}" >&2
        missing=1
    fi
    
    if [[ $missing -eq 1 ]]; then
        exit 1
    fi
}

# Log functions
log_info() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}[INFO]${NC} $1"
}

log_warn() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}[WARN]${NC} $1"
}

log_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}[ERROR]${NC} $1"
}

# Create backup of a file
create_backup() {
    local file="$1"
    local backup_file="${file}.bak"
    
    if [[ ! -f "$backup_file" ]]; then
        cp "$file" "$backup_file"
        log_info "Created backup: $backup_file"
    fi
}

# Restore from backup
restore_backup() {
    local file="$1"
    local backup_file="${file}.bak"
    
    if [[ -f "$backup_file" ]]; then
        cp "$backup_file" "$file"
        log_info "Restored from backup: $file"
        return 0
    else
        log_warn "No backup found for: $file"
        return 1
    fi
}

# Undo all backups
undo_all() {
    local restored=0
    local failed=0
    
    log_info "Undoing compression - restoring all backups..."
    
    while IFS= read -r -d '' bak_file; do
        local original="${bak_file%.bak}"
        if restore_backup "$original"; then
            ((restored++))
        else
            ((failed++))
        fi
    done < <(find "$PROJECT_ROOT" -name "*.bak" -type f -print0 2>/dev/null)
    
    log_info "Restored $restored file(s), $failed failed"
    
    # Remove backup files after successful restore
    find "$PROJECT_ROOT" -name "*.bak" -type f -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    log_info "Cleanup complete"
}

# Compress text based on mode
compress_text() {
    local text="$1"
    local mode="$2"
    
    case "$mode" in
        light)
            # Remove extra whitespace between words
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/  */ /g')
            # Trim leading/trailing whitespace from lines
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
            ;;
        balanced)
            # Remove extra whitespace
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/  */ /g')
            # Trim lines
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
            # Remove consecutive blank lines (keep single blank lines)
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed '/^$/N;/^\n$/d')
            # Simplify common verbose phrases
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/please make sure/ensure/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/please ensure/ensure/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/make sure that/make sure/gi')
            ;;
        aggressive)
            # All balanced operations plus more
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/  */ /g')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//')
            # Remove all blank lines
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed '/^$/d')
            # More aggressive phrase simplification
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/please make sure/ensure/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/please ensure/ensure/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/make sure that/make sure/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/in order to/to/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/is able to/can/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/have to/must/gi')
            text=$(echo "$text" | sed 's/would like to/want to/gi')
            ;;
    esac
    
    echo "$text"
}

# Process a single file
process_file() {
    local file="$1"
    local mode="$2"
    local dry_run="$3"
    
    # Skip if already a backup
    [[ "$file" == *.bak ]] && return 0
    
    # Read file content
    local content
    content=$(cat "$file")
    
    # Compress
    local compressed
    compressed=$(compress_text "$content" "$mode")
    
    # Check if content changed
    if [[ "$content" == "$compressed" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    
    if [[ "$dry_run" == "true" ]]; then
        log_info "Would compress: $file"
        return 0
    fi
    
    # Create backup
    create_backup "$file"
    
    # Write compressed content
    echo "$compressed" > "$file"
    log_info "Compressed: $file"
}

# Find and process target files
process_files() {
    local mode="$1"
    local dry_run="$2"
    local verbose="$3"
    
    log_info "Processing files with mode: $mode"
    
    # Target patterns from config
    local patterns=("*.md" "*.txt" "*.prompt")
    
    for pattern in "${patterns[@]}"; do
        while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            # Skip excluded directories
            [[ "$file" == *"/node_modules/"* ]] && continue
            [[ "$file" == *"/.git/"* ]] && continue
            [[ "$file" == *"/vendor/"* ]] && continue
            [[ "$file" == *".bak" ]] && continue
            
            process_file "$file" "$mode" "$dry_run"
        done < <(find "$PROJECT_ROOT" -name "$pattern" -type f -print0 2>/dev/null)
    done
}

# Show status
show_status() {
    local bak_count
    bak_count=$(find "$PROJECT_ROOT" -name "*.bak" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    
    echo "=== Trinity Compress Status ==="
    echo "Project root: $PROJECT_ROOT"
    echo "Config file: $CONFIG_FILE"
    echo "Backup files: $bak_count"
    echo ""
    
    if [[ -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
        echo "Available modes:"
        jq -r '.modes | keys[]' "$CONFIG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (unable to parse config)"
    fi
}

# Main function
main() {
    local mode=""
    local verbose="false"
    local dry_run="false"
    
    # Parse arguments
    while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
        case "$1" in
            light|balanced|aggressive|undo|status)
                mode="$1"
                shift
                ;;
            -v|--verbose)
                verbose="true"
                shift
                ;;
            --dry-run)
                dry_run="true"
                shift
                ;;
            -h|--help)
                usage
                ;;
            *)
                log_error "Unknown option: $1"
                usage
                ;;
        esac
    done
    
    # Check requirements
    check_requirements
    
    # Handle undo
    if [[ "$mode" == "undo" ]]; then
        undo_all
        exit 0
    fi
    
    # Handle status
    if [[ "$mode" == "status" ]]; then
        show_status
        exit 0
    fi
    
    # Validate mode
    if [[ -z "$mode" ]]; then
        log_warn "No mode specified, using 'balanced'"
        mode="balanced"
    fi
    
    # Validate mode is supported
    if [[ ! "$mode" =~ ^(light|balanced|aggressive)$ ]]; then
        log_error "Invalid mode: $mode"
        usage
    fi
    
    # Process files
    if [[ "$dry_run" == "true" ]]; then
        log_warn "Dry run mode - no changes will be made"
    fi
    
    process_files "$mode" "$dry_run" "$verbose"
    
    log_info "Compression complete"
}

# Run main
main "$@"
SCRIPT\n",
